definitions.explanation: Telling someone again, firmly, so that there is no misunderstanding or forgetting: confirming a time, a promise, a rule. The noun of {念|ねん}を{押|お}す; it takes する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{念押|ねんお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher gave us a firm reminder about the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{念押|ねんお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: It was an important appointment, so I sent a reminder email again the day before.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ "care, attention" and the stem of ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ "to press."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念押|ねんお}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remind firmly, to make sure
- {念押|ねんお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧/⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: a reminder email/call
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{念押|ねんお}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remind someone again and again

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{念|ねん}を{押|お}す→念を押す：33951_nenwoosu⟧: to make sure — the verb phrase
- ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation — neutral checking, without the insistence
